url.description: Open github.com pull request URL ending at the PR number, for example https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123. Remove sub-page suffixes such as /files or /commits. Also accepts https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/123.

notify_on.description: PR events to report; omitted reports all. checks_done reports when no checks remain pending, including pass/fail. Workflow runs always report status and completion.

resume.description: Resume a paused monitor by its saved monitor id.
